text: World War II ended in 1945. The war in Europe concluded on May 8, 1945 (V-E Day, or Victory in Europe Day), following Germany's surrender. The war in the Pacific ended on September 2, 1945 (V-J Day, or Victory over Japan Day), when Japan formally signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri, following the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945.
